about.label: About LENS
about.hero_description: A research-driven think tank working to strengthen Bangladesh's narrative ecosystem through evidence, media literacy, strategic communication and policy engagement.
about.mission_p1: LENS exists at the intersection of research, capacity building, communication and policy engagement. We believe in evidence-based approaches to strengthening Bangladesh's narrative ecosystem.
about.mission_p2: Our team of researchers, media professionals, and policy experts work together to produce actionable insights for journalists, civil society organizations, and policymakers.
about.value_evidence_desc: All our work is grounded in rigorous research and data analysis.
about.value_independence_desc: We maintain editorial and research independence from all stakeholders.
about.value_transparency_desc: Our methodology, funding and findings are openly shared.
about.value_impact_desc: We measure success by real-world change in Bangladesh's narrative landscape.
about.team_description: LENS brings together researchers, journalists, and policy experts dedicated to improving Bangladesh's information ecosystem.
